items.body: You can now measure realtime replies from the last detected user speech to first assistant playback when you configure local VAD. Read the latency from assistant message metrics: - **TLS**: contexts are cached per trust configuration; restart workers after replacing a CA bundle at the same path. - **Google**: instruction-free realtime replies are allowed on immutable-context models; unavailable timing is reported as unknown. Recording shutdown, VAD resizing, interruption teardown, chat summaries, structured outputs, multilingual sentence splitting, and tool discovery are more reliable.
